result.document_summary: A portion of a code-publisher page (URL for San Diego's algorithmic rent-price-fixing division) that actually contains San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 2 Administrative Code provisions on city records management and city contractor equal employment opportunity.
result.notes: This part contains only San Diego Municipal Code Chapter 2, Article 2 text (Division 25 claims responsibility, Division 26 records management, Division 27 Equal Employment Opportunity Outreach Program). None of it concerns rent increase limits, just-cause eviction, security deposits, screening fees, screening restrictions, or algorithmic rent setting. The text of the algorithmic rent-setting division named in the URL (§ 98.1103) does not appear in this part, so no rules are extracted.
